paite: Huan misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw, Galatia gam a saptuam pawlte kiang a thu ka piak bang in nou leng na hih sam un.
heading: Khristian Thilpiak
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in michih in vualzawlna na muh bang zel un koih khawl chiat un; ka hong chiang a lakkhawm himhim a-omlouhna ding in.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

paite: Huan na hehpih thilpiak uh Jerusalem a hohpih ding in ka hong tun chiang in kuapeuh hoih na chih ua lai na piak uh ka sawl ding hi.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan kei va hoh kilawm ahihleh, kei toh ahoh ding uhi.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

paite: Huan Masidonia gam ka totsuah khit chiang in na kiang uah ka hong ding a; Masidonia gam ka tuansuak himhim ding hi.
heading: Mimal Ngetnate
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

paite: Na kiang uah bang tan hiam, phalbi sung teng houh ka taam nilouh kha diam; ka hohna ding peuh a noute'n na hon khaksawn theihna ding un.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

paite: Tua pai kawm lel a hon muh malam ka ut kei a, Toupa'n lem asakleh na kiang ua sawt sim taam ka lamen hi.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

paite: Himahleh Pentikost ni tan in Ephesa ah ka taam ding hi.
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

paite: Kong lianpi, phatuampi sepna ding kei a ding in akihong ngal a; huan dou mite leng tampi a-om uh.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

paite: Huan Timothi ahong tunleh lauthawng lou a na kiang ua a-omna ding in pilvang un; ke'n ka sep bangmah in Toupa nna asem hi.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

paite: Huaiziak in kuamah in musit kei uhen; ka kiang a ahong theihna ding in khamuangtak in khakhia unla; unaute toh amah muh ka lamen hi.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

paite: I unaupa Apollos thu zaw, unaute toh na kiang ua hong ding in ka deih ngial hi, himahleh tu'n zaw hong a-ut kei a; alemtan hun chiang in ahong ding hi.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

paite: Kiveng unla, ginna ah dingkip un, kihihhang unla, hattak in om un.
heading: Thuhilhna Nanungte
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

paite: Na hih peuhmah uh itna a hih hi vek hen.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

paite: Unaute aw, Stephenas inkuan-pihte zaw Akhaia gam a gingta masate ahi ua, misiangthoute nna sem ding in akipia uh chih na thei uhi;
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

paite: huchibang mite kiang ah leh nasep a panpih leh semgim peuhte kiang a lut ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

paite: Huan Stephenas, Fortunate leh Akaikas ahong tun uh ka kipak hi; noute hih louh kilang lou a ka taksapna hon huh ziak un.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

paite: Amau ka lungsim leh na lungsim uh hon hihhalh ua, hichibang mite zaw kipahpih un.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

paite: Asia gam a saptuam pawlte'n chibai hon buk uhi. Akuila, Priscilla leh a-inn ua om saptuamte'n deihsaktak in Toupa ah chibai hon buk uhi.
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

paite: Unau tengteng in chibai hon buk uhi. Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

paite: Kei Paul in hiai chibai bukna keimah khut mahmah a ka gelh ahi.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

paite: Kuapeuh in Toupa Jesu Khrist a-it keileh hamsethuak in om hen. I Toupa ahong pai hi.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

paite: Khrist Jesu a ka itna na vek ua lak ah om hen. Amen.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
